prompt: ECMAScript IsTypedArrayOutOfBounds zero-length ByteOffset equals bufferByteLength
answer:
No. Under the shown `IsTypedArrayOutOfBounds` algorithm, a zero-length TypedArray whose `[[ByteOffset]]` equals `bufferByteLength` is **not** out of bounds.

The condition is:

```text
If byteOffsetStart > bufferByteLength
or byteOffsetEnd > bufferByteLength, return true.
```

Because equality is allowed, the operation returns `false`; the specification note explicitly says that “0-length TypedArrays are not considered out-of-bounds.”【https://github.com/LadybirdBrowser/ladybird/blob/abfd5ab8/Libraries/LibJS/Runtime/TypedArray.cpp】
